{{Top|leg|title=k-43 heavy laser cannon}}
The '''k-43 heavy laser cannon''' was a prototype [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] constructed by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. One of the prototypes was acquired by [[Elea Poista]], and she arranged to deliver it to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Miser/Legends|Miser]].
